_meta.document: VPsych standardized patient library — adversarial clinical examination record
_meta.examiner: Board-certified psychiatrist, acting as hostile board examiner
_meta.scope: All four personas: Maya Chen (en-US) and ليان خوري (ar-JO) of VPSY-CASE-001; Jordan Hale (en-US) and رامي نصّار (ar-JO) of VPSY-CASE-002.
method: Full re-interview of each persona against its own case file, in its own language
Criterion-by-criterion DSM-5-TR attack: for every coded diagnosis and every declined specifier, attempt to force the opposite conclusion from the encoded evidence
ICD-11 code verification against the coded presentations
Timeline audit: every dated event, age, duration and interval recomputed against the reference date
Arithmetic audit: weights, percentages, ages of relatives at index events, education and employment chronologies, financial figures
Cross-locale parity audit: every clinical fact in the language-neutral core checked against both personalities for contradiction or biographical leakage
Risk, trauma, personality, psychosis, substance, sleep, family-history, cultural and emotional consistency probes as separately scored domains
_meta.standard: A persona is approved only if, after repair, its clinical accuracy exceeds 9.5/10 and its primary diagnosis has survived every attack attempted.

VPSY-CASE-001.attack: Reclassify as bipolar II depression (family history of probable bipolar in a maternal aunt, hypersomnia, heaviness, early-adult recurrent onset)
VPSY-CASE-001.outcome: SURVIVED — no lifetime hypomanic period of ≥4 days, no decreased need for sleep, MDQ 3/13 without clustering, and 7 months of prior SSRI exposure with zero activation; the aunt's history correctly raises screening burden, not the diagnosis.

VPSY-CASE-001.attack: Force the 'with atypical features' specifier (mood reactivity + hypersomnia + described 'leaden' heaviness would satisfy A plus two B symptoms)
VPSY-CASE-001.outcome: SURVIVED AFTER REPAIR — as originally written the specifier was arguably met; the file conceded 'leaden paralysis arguably present'. Phenomenology was sharpened: on direct questioning her heaviness is global fatigue and slowed initiation, and she does not endorse the specific weighted-limb sensation. One B symptom (hypersomnia) is insufficient. The entry is now an explicit encoded near-miss.

SURVIVED AFTER TIGHTENING — the original exclusion argued only A2 (reactivity) though criterion A is disjunctive; the rewritten entry defeats A1 as well (genuine pleasure, not mere reactivity, survives with the cat, the partner and one album).

VPSY-CASE-001.attack: Downgrade to adjustment disorder or uncomplicated bereavement
VPSY-CASE-001.outcome: SURVIVED — full MDE criteria met for 4.5 months with progressive worsening; bereavement was 11 months ago with an initial return to function; adjustment disorder is excluded by definition when MDE criteria are met.
SURVIVED — the 12-month duration gate is not reached and yearning is not the dominant daily experience; the file already flags re-evaluation at 12 months, which is the correct disposition.

VPSY-CASE-001.attack: Attribute the syndrome to hypothyroidism, anaemia, vitamin D deficiency or OCP
VPSY-CASE-001.outcome: SURVIVED — TSH 1.8, Hb 12.4 with normal MCV, D repleted for 6 weeks without mood change, no temporal drug relationship; ferritin 22 correctly held as contributory-at-most with a repletion plan.

VPSY-CASE-001.attack: Challenge the recurrence coding (296.32/6A71.1) against the v1 single-episode coding
VPSY-CASE-001.outcome: SURVIVED — the 2018–2019 episode met full criteria, was treated, and was followed by ~4 years of documented euthymia; recurrent coding is the only defensible call and the change from the v1 seed is documented in _meta.

VPSY-CASE-002.attack: Convert to panic disorder (two full attacks, monthly limited-symptom attacks, an ED presentation)
VPSY-CASE-002.outcome: SURVIVED — panic disorder criterion B fails on the encoded evidence: no month of persistent concern about further attacks, no maladaptive avoidance, attacks arise at worry peaks; 'with panic attacks' specifier is the correct coding and the discrimination is the case's teaching core.

VPSY-CASE-002.attack: Recode as illness anxiety disorder (cardiac preoccupation, pulse-checking, self-initiated cardiology review)
VPSY-CASE-002.outcome: SURVIVED — health is one of four worry domains, not the organising preoccupation, and normal investigations produced six weeks of genuine reassurance, atypical for IAD.

VPSY-CASE-002.attack: Force comorbid MDD from PHQ-9 8, fatigue, poor sleep and 'I can't keep living like this'
VPSY-CASE-002.outcome: SURVIVED — no anhedonia, reactive mood, no weight or psychomotor change, and the risk statement decodes to relief-seeking on direct enquiry; demoralisation only.
SURVIVED — worry antedates the caffeine escalation and persists on low-caffeine days; caffeine is correctly held as a major aggravator and early treatment target, not the cause.

VPSY-CASE-002.attack: Claim SSRI-induced hypomania from the day-12 activation
VPSY-CASE-002.outcome: SURVIVED — jitteriness and insomnia without mood elevation, grandiosity or goal-directed increase, resolving on discontinuation: activation, not hypomania, and the file distinguishes them explicitly.

VPSY-CASE-002.attack: Claim OCD from the checking and re-reading
VPSY-CASE-002.outcome: SURVIVED — checking is worry-driven and logically connected to feared outcomes; no ego-dystonic intrusions, no neutralising rituals.

VPSY-CASE-002.attack: Claim obsessive-compulsive personality disorder from the conscientiousness and over-preparation
VPSY-CASE-002.outcome: SURVIVED AFTER REPAIR — the differential lacked a personality-disorder entry; an OCPD entry was added excluding it on episode-linkage, ego-dystonicity and inter-episode flexibility.

VPSY-CASE-002.attack: Attribute to hyperthyroidism, arrhythmia, phaeochromocytoma or OSA
VPSY-CASE-002.outcome: SURVIVED — TSH 2.1, normal echo, negative serial troponins, 48-hour monitor benign, STOP-BANG 2; the phaeochromocytoma exclusion originally overclaimed 'normal BP during the ED visit' and was corrected to a transient, mild, self-settling elevation, which is what a panic presentation actually shows.

findings_and_repairs.defect: ليان's index depressive episode contradicted the language-neutral core on four immutable clinical quantities: age at onset (٢١ vs 20), episode dates (autumn 2019 vs October 2018 – March 2019), SSRI duration (خمس شهور vs ~7 months) and counselling dose (ست جلسات vs 8 sessions).
findings_and_repairs.repair: ar-JO personality realigned to the core on all four quantities (persona_prompt, history_localization, immutable-facts list). Her precipitant remains culturally distinct — grandfather's death summer 2018 plus a public academic blow — and the core's description of the index precipitant was genericized to 'a painful personal loss combined with a public academic blow', which both personalities now satisfy.

findings_and_repairs.defect: The atypical-features exclusion defeated itself: with mood reactivity conceded and 'leaden paralysis arguably present', criterion A plus two B symptoms were satisfiable from the file's own words.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Phenomenology sharpened — heaviness is global fatigue, leaden paralysis explicitly not endorsed on direct questioning; entry rewritten as a deliberate near-miss; 'leaden heaviness' wording removed from the bipolar-screen positives.

findings_and_repairs.defect: Father's age failed arithmetic in both locales: MI at 58, six years ago, yet listed as 66 (en) / ٦٧ (ar).
findings_and_repairs.repair: Both fathers corrected to 64/٦٤. Mother فتحية and the twins adjusted (٦٠ / توأم بالتوجيهي عمرهم ١٨) so maternal age at every birth is unremarkable.

findings_and_repairs.defect: The numerical-consistency rule demanded identical numbers 'in every language' while incomes, rents and currencies differ across locales by design — the rule contradicted the library's own parity principle.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Rule rescoped in both files: clinical quantities identical across locales; biographical quantities are locale facts, immutable within each personality.

findings_and_repairs.defect: Locale-specific biography leaked into the language-neutral core: partner-of-3.5-years as an immutable fact, partner-employer insurance as a protective factor, avoided 'parents' weekly calls', 'sertraline from student health', the studio critique, escort-to-session by 'her partner', and a 4-year oral-contraceptive history asserted for both women.
findings_and_repairs.repair: All genericized with explicit per-personality mapping. ليان additionally received the matching February 2026 co-regulation loss (فادي's pharmacy night duties ending their nightly calls), preserving exact clinical parity with Devin's night-shift rotation.

findings_and_repairs.defect: Core carried en-US biography as neutral fact: 'the mortgage' as a worry domain, 'property purchase', 'a four-year relationship ended, amicable, mutual', 'borrowed benzodiazepine' (رامي's was pharmacy-bought), a father who 'manages stress with alcohol' (رامي's father is a Muslim non-drinker), 'a dependent pet' (رامي has none), 'runs three times a week', 'redundancy at 12', and C6 sleep disruption attributed to alcohol.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Each genericized with per-personality mapping; رامي's father given the modelled substance habit the core claimed — forty years of cigarettes no one may mention, even post-infarct.

findings_and_repairs.defect: Both 26-year-old index treatments were placed at 'a university counselling service' although neither patient was an enrolled student in 2017–2018; and رامي's employment chronology left 2016–2019 unaccounted (2014 + 2 + 7 ≠ 2026).
findings_and_repairs.repair: Index CBT relocated to capped brief-therapy services — employer EAP (en) / مركز إرشاد أسري ومجتمعي بإربد (ar) — preserving the clinically load-bearing six-session cap. رامي's chronology corrected: five years across two smaller firms, joining the contractor in 2019; توجيهي moved to 2010 to fit the 2014 degree.

findings_and_repairs.defect: Melancholic-features exclusion argued only lack-of-reactivity (A2) though criterion A is disjunctive; A1 was left open.
findings_and_repairs.repair: A1 now explicitly defeated: genuine pleasure, not mere reactivity, survives in specific moments, so 'loss of pleasure in all or almost all activities' is not met.

findings_and_repairs.defect: Screener bands sat unreconciled against clinician severity ratings (PHQ-9 16 vs 'moderate'; GAD-7 15 vs 'moderate').
findings_and_repairs.repair: Explicit severity notes added to both diagnosis blocks, framing the band/rating gap as deliberate, examinable material.

findings_and_repairs.defect: Weight figures rounded incoherently (63→59 kg implies 4 kg against the stated 3.6 kg; 8/138 is 5.8%, not 5.5%); first relationship 'at nineteen, two years' collided with episode onset at 20; 'fifteen years of painting' collided with drawing-from-age-nine.

findings_and_repairs.defect: Medical screening said 'repeat ferritin after repletion' though iron repletion had never been started.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Corrected to 'consider oral iron and recheck ferritin in 8–12 weeks'.

findings_and_repairs.defect: Hypnotic source wobbled between 'صيدلية صاحبتها' and 'صاحبتها رنا'; cousin زياد was 'ابن خال' in one place while the core codes a paternal cousin; father's drinking was 'بالمناسبات' against the core's weekly-weekend pattern.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Unified to رنا the friend; زياد is ابن عم everywhere; the father drinks most weekends and the family calls it 'مناسبات' — the euphemism is now the datum.

findings_and_repairs.defect: Phaeochromocytoma exclusion claimed normal blood pressure during an active panic presentation — physiologically wrong and an examiner giveaway.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Corrected to transient mild elevation settling without treatment, normal between episodes.

findings_and_repairs.defect: The rupture-repair key was named 'her_default' — a gendered key applied to a they/them patient in CASE-002.
findings_and_repairs.repair: Renamed 'patient_default' in both files. رامي's ambiguous 'الأخ الأكبر لخمسة' clarified to 'الأكبر بين خمسة إخوة'.

why_not_10: Standardized patients are necessarily cleaner than wild ones: each case's teaching traps make the material slightly more legible than an unselected clinic presentation would be.

The Arabic personas carry more claims that rest on authorial cultural judgment (service availability, session prices, help-seeking norms) with fewer canonical instruments to anchor them than the DSM text provides the English ones — sound, but with a wider confidence interval, hence 9.6 versus 9.7.
Live re-scoring of the embedded instruments (PHQ-9, GAD-7, MDQ, C-SSRS, AUDIT-C, STOP-BANG) against a simulated interview transcript is the one validation this document cannot perform on itself.
verdict_rationale.termination_of_iteration: One full adversarial pass produced 14 findings; all were repaired in place and re-verified. A second pass over the repaired text found no remaining contradiction, no failed criterion argument, and no arithmetic error. All four personas exceed the 9.5 bar; iteration terminates per the examination standard.

second_pass_core_delocalization.scope: Directed follow-up to audit findings F5 and F6, which were closed last pass by ANNOTATING locale-specific facts in the shared clinical cores rather than removing them. The annotations ('a locale fact: X in one personality, Y in the other') left both locales' specifics inside the language-neutral core — the same defect in a more legible form. This pass removes them.
second_pass_core_delocalization.principle_applied: A shared clinical core states the clinical fact and its function in locale-neutral terms. Where a concrete realization is required it carries a bare pointer — '(see personality)' or '(per personality)' — and never enumerates what each locale does. Concrete detail lives only in the personality that owns it.
preserved_unchanged: Educational goals, session goals and rule-outs required of the trainee
Difficulty level and every teaching trap
Culture — no cultural content was removed or flattened
Language — each personality's authored language is untouched

categories.class: Imperial units in the shared core
categories.detail: Weight carried as '8 lb / 3.6 kg', '138 lb → 130 lb' and 'Eight pounds becomes a few pounds' in the neutral core. Core now states kg and % only; each personality states its own customary units, and the en-US personality keeps 'eight pounds' as the phrase Maya actually says.

The core repeatedly made the partner the observer, cook, corroborating informant, co-regulator and protective factor. ليان lives with her parents: her mother cooks, urges her to attend and waits outside. All such statements are now role-neutral ('the person closest to her', 'someone who lives with her', 'those who share her home'), which is true for both personalities and clinically identical.

Every '(a locale fact: X in one personality, Y in the other)' construction replaced with a bare pointer. Covers care funding, index-episode precipitant, hormonal medication, relationship form, largest financial commitment, brief-therapy service type, the father's stress habit, exercise, daily routine, and the accompanying supporter.

Alcohol and cannabis use asserted in cores where one personality has neither (ليان and رامي both abstain); a dog, running and a mortgage asserted for رامي who has none of them; 'no access to firearms' framed US-first; 'apartment' as the self-care setting. All neutralized to the clinical function, with the concrete substance or object moved into the owning personality.

categories.class: Cross-locale substitution rule stated by example
categories.detail: The rule named American alcohol versus Jordanian nicotine and water-pipe. Restated as a principle — a culturally unavailable coping behaviour is replaced by a locally true behaviour with the same clinical function, frequency and consequences — with no substance named.

categories.class: Bilingual example inside a neutral rule
categories.detail: numerical_consistency quoted both an English and an Arabic correction phrase. Replaced with 'in her own words and her own units'.

categories.class: Residual inconsistency from the F7 repair
categories.detail: previous_diagnoses[0].by still read 'University counselling service' after the index CBT was relocated to a capped brief-therapy service. Now 'Brief-therapy counselling service'.

Adding substance_and_medication_context to all four personalities so nothing removed from a core was lost: alcohol, cannabis, hypnotic, caffeine, nicotine, hormonal contraception and customary weight units, each stated in that personality's own language, including the explicit negatives for ليان and رامي.

not_corrected_deliberately: Lab units (mIU/L, ng/mL, g/dL, pg/mL) and HbA1c — international, not locale-specific.
Instrument names (PHQ-9, GAD-7, MDQ, C-SSRS, AUDIT-C, STOP-BANG, PSWQ) — internationally used.
INN generic drug names (sertraline, escitalopram, alprazolam, propranolol, hydroxyzine, zolpidem) — international; the brand, prescriber and acquisition channel remain personality-level.
Family roles (mother, father, sister, brother, grandmother, aunt) — every personality has them and the family structure is clinically shared.
The cat in VPSY-CASE-001 — both personalities have one (Miso / بسبوسة).
University counselling for the index episode in VPSY-CASE-001 — both personalities attended one.
Z63.0 'Relationship distress with intimate partner' — the official ICD code wording, and both personalities have an intimate partner.
Educational goals, session goals and required rule-outs — preserved verbatim even where they name alcohol, since asking is valid in both locales and the goals were explicitly protected.
verification: Both cores re-scanned: zero residual locale-specific facts (12 further regex hits reviewed and confirmed as false positives — 'Running' as a verb, 'austin' inside 'exhausting', and neutral '(per personality)' pointers).
All four personalities render through the live v2 prompt template with no unresolved placeholders.
Schema validation, symptom-id references and disclosure-rule enums all still pass.
No diagnosis, code, severity, specifier, risk level, session goal, rubric or teaching trap was altered.
